scope: The Old Fort of Zanzibar in Stone Town in July 2004. The model covers the crenellated coral-stone perimeter, towers, gates, and two open courtyards.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: UNESCO identifies the Old Fort as a major Stone Town monument on the earlier Portuguese church site.
The architectural site record identifies the seafront relationship to the House of Wonders and earlier church remains in the main courtyard.
Excavation record documents the western court and the earlier church remains. The eastern court was remodelled for an open-air amphitheatre before 2004.
